data.title: Unit 9: Electricity and Magnetism
Magnetism
data.rubric: Click the correct option to say whether these statements are True or False.

question1.text: Like poles of a magnet attract each other.

question2.text: Magnetic fields are very strong around the poles.

question3.text: A magnetic field is a visible area around a magnet.

question4.text: In an electromagnet, when the current is turned off, the magnet still works.

question5.text: Electromagnets work through a combination of electricity and magnetism.
